name: Sierra Leone
people: Where Sierra Leoneans and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect Sierra Leone: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

paras: Your rivers already give three quarters of your power, and you renew more fresh water per person than most of the world. About one in nine of you drinks safely managed water. Let the rivers that light the grid also fill every tap.
letter.quote: “The rivers already light your grid. Let them fill every tap as well.”

mandates.audience: the Government of Sierra Leone, its development partners and investors

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting everyone above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, set with Sierra Leone in its own prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times the population: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate, to be confirmed with Sierra Leone. Figures marked dated rest on surveys more than five years old; lenient measures are marked as such.
capita.measures: Strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking; where electricity per person is not published, clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group. Each figure links to its source.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from Sierra Leone: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API, last updated 8 October 2026), accessed 10 November 2026: population 2025, ages 0 to 14 2025, land area and agricultural and forest land 2024, renewable fresh water per person 2022, natural resource rents 2021, renewable electricity output 2021, electricity access and clean cooking 2024.

The seven standards: FAO food insecurity, WHO/UNICEF JMP water and sanitation, UN-Habitat urban slums, World Bank clean cooking, learning poverty and lower-secondary completion, and poverty headcounts (all via the World Bank); WHO UHC service coverage index, 2023.
IMF, PR 24/432 (22 November 2024), PR 25/425 (16 December 2025), PR 26/213 (18 June 2026) and Country Report No. 26/168 (July 2026).
World Bank press releases of 13 December 2024, 25 September and 30 October 2025, and 10 March, 18 June and 22 June 2026; CGTN, 19 June 2026; each other register line links its own source.
